title: no-dead-code absent from injected run rubric baseline: assets/ and internal/ run.rubrics.md have diverged
description: src/moeb/assets/rubrics/run.rubrics.md contains the no-dead-code criterion (added by moeb.query-agent-tool). src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md contains only context-budget. The running binary reads internal/, so no-dead-code is silently absent from every run's injected Layer-2 baseline despite being the correct authoritative source per moeb.rubric-context-layers. The FrontmatterSchema.optional dead_code warning (src/domain/spec_schema.rs:14) surfaced in cargo test output during run 18aea822-d9eb-4ebc-87ec-06ceb5eda5f7 with no criterion to surface it as a failure.
proposed_resolution: Determine which file the binary reads at runtime for Layer-2 run rubrics (assets/ or internal/). Reconcile both files so they share the same content, or document the authoritative source and remove the stale copy. Once reconciled, no-dead-code will be injected into every run and the FrontmatterSchema.optional warning must be resolved or suppressed.
